main_body: Flat-roofed desert building: a sand-coloured roof terrace with a teal dome on top, over a brick front wall with an arched door and a small lattice window
top_band: Sand-coloured roof surface (L~190, with a lighter 214 rim) at rows 3-33, with a dark parapet shadow at the back and left; a dark brown edge at row 34 closes it
evidence: Column x=32 reads: outline at row 2, a speckled sand roof from rows 3-33 (lighter rim rows 28-33), a dark brown edge at row 34, a shadow at rows 35-36, then the brick wall from row 37 to the bottom. The roof is clearly a horizontal surface seen from above, and the dome sits on it with its own front base. The front face is separate and has an eave shadow. The roof is not foreshortened, so the top is very tall. The door and window have light frames but are mostly painted flat. The 3/4 structure of top band, edge, shadow and front face is still readable, so Part A passes.

style.evidence: The outlines are tinted dark brown (0% neutral), and the sand speckle and brick tones give some texture. The ramps are shallow at about 4 steps per material, against about 6 on the references. Only 30 distinct colours versus 66 and 185 on the references, and 8 colours per tile versus 11 and 18. The door, dome and wall are simply shaded, and the flat roof has no tile or scallop detail. It sits noticeably thinner than both references.
